title: 第 K 個排列 / K-th permutation
prompt: Input {items:[distinct integers],k:zero-based-index}. Return the k-th permutation in lexicographic ascending order, regardless of initial item order. k outside 0..n!-1 or repeated items raises ValueError. n<=7; the empty list has one permutation []. Do not mutate input.
baseline:
def solve(data):
    a = list(data['items'])
    if len(set(a))!=len(a):
        raise ValueError
    factorial = [1]
    for i in range(1,len(a)+1):
        factorial.append(factorial[-1]*i)
    k = data['k']
    if k<0 or k>=factorial[-1]:
        raise ValueError
    out = []
    while a:
        block = factorial[len(a)-1]
        index = k//block
        k %= block
        out.append(a.pop(index))
    return out
reference:
def solve(data):
    a = sorted(data['items'])
    if len(set(a))!=len(a):
        raise ValueError
    factorial = [1]
    for i in range(1,len(a)+1):
        factorial.append(factorial[-1]*i)
    k = data['k']
    if k<0 or k>=factorial[-1]:
        raise ValueError
    out = []
    while a:
        block = factorial[len(a)-1]
        index = k//block
        k %= block
        out.append(a.pop(index))
    return out
